about: Job titles with the role and the level each must get (role null: the title is none of the 50 roles). Labelled by reading, before the rules were run on them (2026-10-12): 470 titles drawn from the scraped postings by plain keyword and at random, 159 written to probe the edges. Rows with sure=false are reported, not counted. Checked by evals/run_pipeline.py. Rows with set "entry-2026-10-13" (148) were added when campus titles, sector bankers and the entry-level grades of manager roles were brought in; they were labelled from the rules of that decision, before the patterns were written. "category_before" marks a row whose employer got a category after it was labelled (Fortune banks and investors). Set entry-mark-2026-10-13: 6 real titles that show two level rules were wrong ("Sr." not read as "Senior" on the bank and consulting ladders; a grade word inside the name of an MBA programme). Set ai-transformation-2026-10-30 (16): the AI transformation role, added on 2026-10-30 from titles the backlog holds and 2026 postings found by search (Head of AI Transformation, AI Enablement Lead); the written rows pin its edges (engineers and research labs are not the role, AI strategy stays tech_strategy, a consultant at a consulting firm stays management_consultant). Set business-roles-2026-11-05 (113): the 13 business roles of the 2026-11-05 role-coverage audit (account executive and SDR, solutions engineer, data scientist, data or business analyst, project manager, recruiter, implementation and customer experience, communications, demand generation, market research, sustainability, public policy, fraud and credit risk), labelled from census titles of 2026-11-04 and written edges before the patterns were written; 17 older null rows took one of the new roles (marked "relabelled", the reason in the note). Set noise-2026-11-06 (7): titles the skills pass of 2026-11-06 found landing in the new roles by a word that means something else there (CSR as customer service, ESG as a business-unit code, Climate Solutions as a segment name, implementation as chip or network build, janitorial project managers); each note says why.
